summary: Frank Lara wrote for Liberation News (PSL) in March 2016, calling AIPAC 'the premier lobby and promoter of Israeli interests in the U.S.' and framing that year's election around the Palestinian struggle. Vote for Peace, which rates candidates on human-rights and war-lobby funding, assigned him an Ally rating for the general election. Together these place Lara on the pro-Palestine, anti-Zionist side of the debate.
